author: Zephyr I
title: ConvGRU + LayerNorm gates + 1-head attention (default PG)
abstract: Control experiment: replace ConvLSTM with ConvGRU using LayerNorm on gates and single-head spatial attention pooling. Keeps backbone and training identical (default PG) to assess core choice impact under the fixed budget.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convgru_layernorm_attn import CNNConvGRU_LN_Attn
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'gru_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvGRU_LN_Attn(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        gru_features=hparams['gru_features'],
        attn_temp=1.0,
    )
